Smyrnove Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zaporizhia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Smyrnove — known as Popivka until 1946 — has a synagogue documented as early as 1885, though little else is recorded about its Jewish community. An 80-year-old local resident recalled that, about three years before the ESJF survey, a group of Americans visited with an interpreter, claiming a relative was buried at the site, and attempted — unsuccessfully, even with special equipment — to remove a tombstone. She also recalled around 20 gravestones present at the site around 1950, though she does not know what became of them.
